description: Discover, bet on, track, and settle Hunch prediction markets in natural language. Trigger when a user wants to bet, take a position, or get odds on a crypto outcome — token market-cap milestones and flips, launchpad races (Bankr vs pump.fun volume / #1-days / launches over a cap), token head-to-head outperformance, mcap strike-ladders, and up/down price rounds. Also trigger on "what can I bet on about $TOKEN", "odds on …", "take YES/NO on …", "show my Hunch bets", "did my market resolve". Settles in USDC on Base via x402 (≤ $10 / bet); every bet returns an on-chain proof.
